$comment: Single source of truth for the PIPE-1501 digital twin: 14 km DN 1200 ductile iron transmission main, Saint-Gobain PAM NATURAL class C25, cement-mortar lined, pumping to a hilltop reservoir. Pipe data from the PAM data sheets; hydraulics Darcy-Weisbach / Swamee-Jain, Hazen-Williams as the utility check; transients Joukowsky.

twin.kind: Water transmission main with flow meters at both ends, pressure transmitters along the route and transient loggers

standards.performance: Saint-Gobain PAM NATURAL DN 1200 C25: OD 1255 mm, iron wall 13.6 mm, 465.56 kg/m; PFA 25 / PMA 30 / PEA 35 bar (EN 545)
standards.hydraulics: Darcy-Weisbach hf = f L/D v^2/2g, Swamee-Jain f = 0.25 / log10(k/3.7D + 5.74/Re^0.9)^2; Hazen-Williams C (SI) as check
standards.transients: Joukowsky dp = rho a dv, Korteweg wave speed a = 1007.1 m/s for DN 1200 C25 ductile iron (computed)
standards.information_model: Points named after the SCADA tags of the line (FIT, PIT, LIT, ZT)

identification.description: Transmission main 1501 (pump station PS-15 to reservoir R-15)
identification.model: NATURAL DN 1200 C25 ductile iron, cement-mortar lined

pipe.lining_note: cement-mortar lining 6 mm assumed (ISO 4179 band DN 700-1200, unverified)
pipe.pressure_note: PMA = 1.2 PFA and PEA = PMA + 5 bar per the EN 545 rule; not read from the PAM row

hydraulics.k_note: k = 0.1 mm for a lined pipe including joints and bends (assumption); DIPRA flow tests give C ~ 140

transients.note: With a working surge vessel a pump trip raises the pressure by about 22 % of Joukowsky (assumed); a failed vessel lets almost the full Joukowsky through

high_point.name: High point HP-1 with air valve AV-3

leak_site.name: Leak site used by the demo (between PT-2 and PT-3)

meters.note: electromagnetic flow meters, +-0.5 % of reading each (typical)

demo.note: The plant clock runs 60x real time (one day in 24 min): the pump schedule (3 pumps at night, 2 by day, 1 in the evening peak) changes several times per real hour; injected faults ramp in 1-3 min.

points.label: Flow at the pump station (FM-A, electromagnetic)
Pressure at the pump station outlet (PT-0, ch 0.0 km)
Pressure at chamber C-1 (PT-1, ch 3.5 km)
Pressure at chamber C-2 (PT-2, ch 7.0 km)
Pressure at chamber C-3 (PT-3, ch 10.5 km)
Pressure at the reservoir inlet chamber (PT-4, ch 14.0 km)
Reservoir water level above the floor
Highest pressure at the pump station in the last minute (1 kHz logger)
Lowest pressure at high point HP-1 in the last minute (1 kHz logger)
Line valve LV-2 position (limit switch / indicator)

leak.label: Leak / burst (between PT-2 and PT-3)
leak.cause: A failed joint or a cracked barrel lets water out at about km 8.2: less water arrives than leaves the pump station, and downstream of the leak the line carries less flow, so the hydraulic grade line flattens there
leak.action: Dispatch a leak crew to the estimated chainage; confirm with acoustic correlation; isolate between LV-2 and the nearest chamber for repair

tuberculation.label: Roughness growth (lining damage, tuberculation)
tuberculation.cause: Damaged lining exposes iron; corrosion nodules and biofilm make the wall rougher: the whole line loses more head for the same flow, and the effective Hazen-Williams C falls
tuberculation.action: Plan a CCTV / pig inspection; swab or reline the affected sections; review water chemistry (Langelier index)

air_pocket.label: Air pocket at high point HP-1 (air valve AV-3 blocked)
air_pocket.cause: The air valve at the high point no longer vents: an air pocket narrows the flow section and adds a local head loss between PT-1 and PT-2
air_pocket.action: Inspect and clean air valve AV-3 (float stuck, orifice blocked); vent the high point

valve_throttled.label: Line valve LV-2 partly closed
valve_throttled.cause: The line valve at km 9.5 was left partly closed after maintenance (its indicator still says open): a local head loss appears between PT-2 and PT-3
valve_throttled.action: Check LV-2 on site, open it fully and repair the position indicator

meter_drift.label: Flow meter FM-B drift
meter_drift.cause: The reservoir inlet meter reads low (electrode fouling or a lost calibration): the mass balance opens up, but the pressures along the line show no leak
meter_drift.action: Verify FM-B against a clamp-on meter or the reservoir level change; clean electrodes and recalibrate

surge_protection.label: Surge vessel failure (pump-trip transients)
surge_protection.cause: The surge vessel at the pump station lost its air charge (bladder or compressor fault): every pump trip now sends a near-Joukowsky pressure wave down the line, above PFA at the station and down to vapour pressure at the high point
surge_protection.action: Restore the surge vessel charge; check the non-return valves; avoid pump starts/stops until fixed

transmitter_fault.label: Pressure transmitter PT-2 drift
transmitter_fault.cause: PT-2 drifts high (diaphragm or zero shift): the head loss looks too small upstream of it and too large downstream, a pattern no hydraulic fault makes
transmitter_fault.action: Check PT-2 against a test gauge; recalibrate or replace

compare.label: Head loss PS -> reservoir
compare.basis: Darcy-Weisbach / Swamee-Jain at the inlet flow, k 0.1 mm, D 1.216 m, L 14 km

compare.label: Pressure PT-1 (km 3.5)
compare.basis: PT-0 + elevation - friction at the inlet flow

compare.label: Pressure PT-2 (km 7.0)
compare.basis: PT-0 + elevation - friction at the inlet flow

compare.label: Pressure PT-3 (km 10.5)
compare.basis: PT-0 + elevation - friction at the inlet flow

compare.label: Pressure PT-4 (reservoir inlet)
compare.basis: PT-0 + elevation - friction at the inlet flow

compare.label: Hazen-Williams C
compare.basis: from the measured head loss vs. the design pipe

design.label: Pipe
design.value: Saint-Gobain PAM NATURAL DN 1200 C25 ductile iron, OD 1255 mm, wall 13.6 mm, cement-mortar lined, 465.56 kg/m

design.label: Pressures
design.value: PFA 25 / PMA 30 / PEA 35 bar (EN 545 class C25)

design.label: Line
design.value: 14.0 km, PS-15 (32 m) to reservoir R-15 (floor 126 m), high point 88 m at km 5.6; 3 x 2100 m³/h pumps

design.label: Source
design.value: PAM data sheets (DN 1200 C25 row); 3D built from the route and pipe dimensions, not manufacturer CAD
